items.title: Can Sensex, Nifty extend gains for second session on Monday? 5 factors that will decide market mood next week
items.description: Indian stock markets ended Friday in positive territory. However, investors should brace for continued volatility. Key factors influencing market direction include escalating Middle East conflicts, fluctuating crude oil prices, foreign investor activity, and the Indian rupee's performance. Global economic signals will also play a crucial role in shaping market sentiment.

items.title: ​10 Sensex stocks with up to 60% upside potential - Are these in your portfolio?​
items.description: Analyst predictions often offer more than just numbers; they reveal where the next wave of market opportunity could emerge. For investors scanning the Sensex for potential outperformers, the latest analyst consensus highlights several heavyweight names that could deliver strong returns in the coming year.According to Trendlyne data, multiple Sensex stocks show promising upside potential over the next 12 months, based on average analyst target prices. This “upside” reflects the expected price gain from current levels, a research-backed indicator for investors looking to position ahead of potential rallies. Among these, 10 Sensex stocks stand out with projected gains of 30% to 60%, signaling solid return prospects in a market that’s becoming increasingly selective.

items.title: Concentration risk in PMS & curated portfolios: Lessons ahead of Sebi’s 2026 overhaul
items.description: India's Portfolio Management Services (PMS) sector is booming, reaching ₹41.59 lakh crore. While concentration can drive returns, SEBI's 2026 rule changes aim to enhance governance and investor protection. The article highlights the hidden risks of layered concentration in both PMS and curated portfolios, urging investors to understand their true economic exposures beyond superficial diversification.

items.title: 9 penny stocks surge up to 430% in 3 months; 2 turn multibaggers. Do you own any?​
items.description: In the last three months, nine penny stocks have delivered impressive gains ranging from 10% to 430%, including three multibaggers. These outperformers were identified using specific filters: a market capitalisation below Rs 1,000 crore, a share price under Rs 20, and a minimum trading volume of 5 lakh shares. This approach helped spotlight low-priced, actively traded micro-cap stocks exhibiting strong upward momentum.Penny stocks continue to draw interest due to their low price points and high return potential. However, they come with substantial risk, marked by low liquidity, sharp volatility, and limited transparency. For investors, success in this space requires more than luck; it demands discipline, thorough research, and a firm grip on risk management. (Data Source: ACE Equity)

items.title: Mcap of five of top-10 most valued firms erodes by Rs 1 lakh cr; HDFC Bank biggest laggard
items.description: The combined market valuation of five of the top-10 most-valued firms eroded by Rs 1 lakh crore last week, with HDFC Bank taking the biggest hit.

items.title: Foreign investors dump Rs 88,000 crore in March; 2026 outflows cross Rs 1 lakh crore
items.description: Foreign investors have pulled out Rs 88,180 crore (about USD 9.6 billion) from Indian equities so far this month, weighed down by escalating tensions in West Asia, a weakening rupee and concerns over the impact of elevated crude oil prices on India's growth and corporate earnings.

items.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday
items.description: Indian markets rose, led by IT, auto, and metal stocks, while banking weakness limited gains. Analysts indicate short-term pullbacks, with global tensions and weak US-European markets keeping investors cautious.

items.title: Market Trading Guide: Buy Aether Industries and Centum Electronics on Monday for short term gains up to 9%. Here’s why

items.title: West Asia conflict, crude oil prices to steer stock markets in holiday-shortened week: Analysts
items.description: Developments related to the ongoing conflict in West Asia and its impact on crude oil prices will continue to rule investors' sentiment in a holiday-shortened week ahead, analysts said.

items.title: Sebi board to consider FPI settlement norms ease, intermediary reforms on Monday
items.description: Markets regulator Sebi board is set to meet on Monday to deliberate on a wide-ranging agenda, including a proposal to ease fund settlement norms for foreign portfolio investors (FPIs), and changes to regulatory frameworks for market intermediaries, people familiar with the matter said.

items.title: Better option in times of volatility and uncertainty: 6 healthcare stocks with upside potential of up to 30%
items.description: As geopolitical tensions escalate in the Gulf region, the global investment landscape is once again grappling with rising crude oil prices and supply chain disruptions. For India, which imports over 80% of its oil requirements, the conflict typically translates into inflationary pressure, a widening current account deficit, and heightened market volatility. But even in this environment, there are a few sectors that not only provide a defensive shelter, but also have robust growth engines insulated from external shocks.

items.title: Govt may consider OFS option for raising public float in IDBI Bank
items.description: The government may consider selling a stake in IDBI Bank through the Offer-for-Sale (OFS) route to increase public shareholding, after the unsuccessful attempt to divest stake in the LIC-controlled lender, sources said.
